svg.title: Calico Tea Garden — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A clearly feline calico cat with distinct ears, muzzle, paws, tail, and orange-black-white coat patches, seated beside a teacup in a garden window. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
